name: Sliced Wasserstein-based Gaussian Cloning Update
definition: A method to determine the scale update for cloned Gaussians by minimizing the difference between the integrated color of the new and old Gaussians along arbitrary 1D slices passing through their centers, ensuring rasterization integral conservation.
summary: Sliced Wasserstein-based Gaussian Cloning Update determines scale updates by minimizing color differences along 1D slices, enforcing integral conservation to improve reconstruction quality over standard densification.
